probes.answer:
Bedtime can be exhausting, and it sounds like you're carrying a lot of worry about it. I don't know yet what bedtime looks like in your house, so I can't tell you what's going wrong. I also don't know what the other moms' bedtimes look like from the inside. Sometimes the picture we see from outside is smoother than what happens behind the door.

What's the hardest part for you: getting started, the length of the routine, or what happens after the lights go out?
